code: power_wr <- function(p_win, p_loss, p_tie, n = 400, r = 0.5, alpha = 0.025) {   s2 <- 4 * (1 + p_tie) / (3 * r * (1 - r) * (1 - p_tie))   pnorm(sqrt(n / s2) * log(p_win / p_loss) - qnorm(1 - alpha)) } summarize <- function(m) {   w <- m[c("w_os", "w_pfs", "w_resp")]   l <- m[c("l_os", "l_pfs", "l_resp")]   t <- 1 - w - l   carry <- c(1, t[1], t[1] * t[2])   joint <- c(m[["p_win"]], m[["p_loss"]], 1 - m[["p_win"]] - m[["p_loss"]])   indep <- c(sum(w * carry), sum(l * carry), prod(t))   out <- rbind(joint = joint, independence = indep)   colnames(out) <- c("p_win", "p_loss", "p_tie")   cbind(out, win_ratio = out[, "p_win"] / out[, "p_loss"],         win_odds = (out[, "p_win"] + out[, "p_tie"] / 2) /           (out[, "p_loss"] + out[, "p_tie"] / 2),         power = power_wr(out[, "p_win"], out[, "p_loss"], out[, "p_tie"])) } s0 <- summarize(m0) s6 <- summarize(m6) round(s0, 3) #>              p_win p_loss p_tie win_ratio win_odds power #> joint        0.552  0.394 0.054     1.401    1.375 0.790 #> independence 0.564  0.416 0.020     1.355    1.347 0.732 round(s6, 3) #>              p_win p_loss p_tie win_ratio win_odds power #> joint        0.545  0.393 0.062     1.386    1.357 0.756 #> independence 0.564  0.416 0.020     1.355    1.347 0.732

code: library(CorOncoEndpoints)  ctl <- OncoArm(pfs.median = 6, orr = 0.30, resp.cor = 0.40,                death.prop = 0.15, os.median = 15, pps.hr.resp = 0.6) trt <- OncoArm(pfs.median = 6 / 0.7, orr = 0.45, resp.cor = 0.40,                death.prop = 0.15, pps.hazard = ctl$gam0, pps.hr.resp = 0.6) ctl                  # calibrated parameters, implied medians and correlations CorEndpoints(trt)    # Corr(PFS, R), Corr(OS, R), Corr(PFS, OS), partial correlation  arms <- list(Control = ctl, Treatment = trt) dat <- rOncoEndpoints(nsim = 1000, n = c(350, 350), arms = arms,                       a.time = c(0, 24), seed = 1)  # number of OS events for 80% power of the one-sided log-rank test at 2.5% RequiredEvents(arms, n = c(350, 350), a.time = c(0, 24), endpoint = "os")  # data at the calendar time of the 366th OS event in each simulated trial cut <- CutoffData(dat, EventTime(dat, events = 366, endpoint = "os"))  # 10 patients per month for 6 months, then 30 per month until 700 patients; # dropout of 5% per year and censoring of PFS at the start of another therapy dat2 <- rOncoEndpoints(nsim = 1000, n = c(350, 350), arms = arms,                        a.time = c(0, 6), a.rate = c(10, 30),                        d.hazard = -log(0.95) / 12, pfs.cens.hazard = 0.01,                        seed = 2)  # OS and response only, with Corr(OS, R) = 0.35 osr <- OncoArm(os.median = 15, orr = 0.30, resp.cor = 0.35,                endpoints = c("os", "response"))
